# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of the summer after Anne's first year of teaching  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless, freckled face. He is noted for his broad grin, perpetual chuckling, and a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, quiet, and lacking in speech, often relying on chuckles or grins instead of talking. Despite his painful lack of conversational ability, he is good-natured, hard-working, and dependable. He admires Anne Shirley immensely, though his shyness prevents him from pursuing her directly.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

- To marry and settle down on his own farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school. As a young man of twenty, he drove Anne, Diana, and his sister Jane to the White Sands Hotel concert, secretly admiring Anne despite his inability to converse with her. When his father deeded the upper farm to him, Billy wished to marry Anne but was too shy to propose himself. He persuaded his sister Jane to propose on his behalf, offering to wait until Anne finished college if necessary. After Anne declined, Billy turned his attentions to Nettie Blewett, whom he married the following June. The couple 'appeared out' at Avonlea church shortly after their wedding before moving into their new home.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
